cases.narrative:
She offered him a cup of mint tea and due to paranoid delusions he believed she was an alien. He lunged at her, knocked her down the basement stairs and inflicted multiple stab wounds to both of her eyes. Jurors heard videotape of a mortally wounded Nancy Chiero plead for help from her son Lee, who had just beaten and stabbed her. “Say someone broke in, call for an ambulance,” Nancy Chiero repeatedly begged of her son as she laid on her basement floor covered in blood. “I’ll call your friends later,” her son replied matter-of-factly.

He made before and after murdering his mother. On the video Nancy is heard moaning as life ebbed away. A brief image of her bloody face and matted down hair flashed on the courtroom television screen. For most of the three-minute video, the camera was fixed on a wall while she is heard groaning and gasping for air.
